source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Group 2 compounds in industry and everyday life (PDF 13-14).

items: Calcium carbonate (choone ka pathar, marble, chalk) tameeri maadda hai aur cement, concrete, aur kaghaz aur plastic mein filler ke taur par use hota hai.
Quicklime (CaO) aur slaked lime (Ca(OH)2) cement, mortar aur plaster banane mein; quicklime steel banane mein mel bhi nikalta hai.
Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) plasterboard (drywall) aur plaster of Paris (CaSO4.1/2H2O) banane mein use hota hai.
Calcium oxide aur calcium carbonate flue-gas desulphurisation (geeli safai) mein bijli gharon ke dhuen se tezaabi sulphur dioxide nikal kar tezaabi barish rokte hain.
Magnesium oxide oonche pighalne ke darje ki wajah se bhattiyon ki andaruni teh (refractory) mein use hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Magnesium dhaat hawai jahazon aur gaariyon ki halki mixed dhaaton aur chamakdar roshni ke liye aatish baazi aur flares mein use hoti hai. Strontium compounds aatish baazi aur flares mein surkh rang dete hain. Beryllium mixed dhaaton ko mazboot karta (springs, aerospace ke purze) aur X-ray tubes mein use hota hai kyunke X-rays is mein se guzar jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Calcium compounds tezaabi barish rokne mein kaise madad karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Flue-gas desulphurisation mein CaO ya CaCO3 bijli ghar ki gases ki tezaabi sulphur dioxide se react kar ke use hawa tak pohanchne se pehle nikal deta hai.

items: Tameer mein CaCO3, CaO, Ca(OH)2 aur gypsum.
CaO/CaCO3 dhuen se SO2 nikalte; MgO bhattiyon ki teh.
